required_behavior: Resolve concept and designation under exact business scope, language and edition.
unsafe_inference: The same label proves the same concept.

required_behavior: Bind the definition to one terminological concept and business scope.
unsafe_inference: A definition defines a word or database field.

required_behavior: Keep examples, counterexamples, characteristics and defining statement distinct.
unsafe_inference: Observed examples completely define the concept.

required_behavior: Publish direction, scope, strength and residual information loss.
Keep concept-scheme placement separate from formal axioms and entailment.
unsafe_inference: A taxonomy broader edge proves OWL subsumption.

required_behavior: Require an exact current delegation and maker-checker evidence.
unsafe_inference: The assigned steward automatically has semantic approval authority.

required_behavior: Use an explicit resolution plan and sealed import closure.
unsafe_inference: Ontology IRI or version IRI is necessarily its retrievable document location.

required_behavior: Refuse or retain an explicit incomplete closure according to declared policy.
unsafe_inference: An unavailable import may be ignored.

required_behavior: Run consistency under the selected formal semantics and exact axiom closure.
unsafe_inference: OWL profile membership proves ontology consistency.

required_behavior: Retain derivation status and inference trace separately.
unsafe_inference: An entailed statement was explicitly asserted or observed.

required_behavior: Return the exact formal outcome without closed-world substitution.

unsafe_inference: SHACL conformance proves ontology consistency, data completeness or real-world truth.

required_behavior: Claim only profile-bound representation isomorphism and digest identity.
unsafe_inference: Equal canonical RDF serialization proves semantic equivalence or truth.

required_behavior: Preserve source assertion reference, provenance and authority.
unsafe_inference: A knowledge graph assertion becomes source truth when released.

required_behavior: Require an exact typed mapping relation and evidence.
unsafe_inference: Same label or close match proves OWL equivalence.

required_behavior: Require deterministic checks and the named human or institutional authority.
unsafe_inference: A model or agent may approve a definition, axiom, mapping, entailment or graph release.
